item.deathsareitems.birch_splinters.desc: Completely useless. No recipes, food or fuel value.
item.deathsareitems.vinys_bucket.desc: Right-click water to summon Viny; sneak-right-click to recall him. With the Drowning Mask equipped, he traps a hostile mob within 8 blocks for 4 seconds, every 15 seconds. Defeat: 30-second cooldown.
item.deathsareitems.jukys_whistle.desc: Right-click to summon Juky; sneak-right-click to recall him. Sneak-right-click Juky with an empty hand to switch guarding and following. Attacks hostile mobs and howls every 20 seconds to push nearby enemies back. Defeat: 30-second cooldown.
item.deathsareitems.cheese_slice.desc: Eat even when full: restores 4 food points; overflow fills the Hunger Staff reserve, up to 100. Heals 1 heart, once every 10 seconds across all slices.
item.deathsareitems.hamburger.desc: Restores 12 food points; overflow fills the Hunger Staff reserve, up to 100. Grants Regeneration II for 5 seconds. Extra burgers refresh the effect.
item.deathsareitems.gustafs_new_book.des: Earned after claiming 10 different death rewards. Sneak-right-click to cycle discovered chapters; right-click to cast at a hostile mob within 24 blocks. All copies share a 15-second cooldown. Bosses take damage without being trapped or moved.

tooltip.deathsareitems.gustafs_jukebox: Earned after 5 different claimed death rewards. Insert a music disc: the owner gains Strength II and Resistance II within 16 blocks. Every 5 seconds, a pulse deals 16 damage to hostile mobs. Multiple jukeboxes do not stack.
